type: object (`Image`: `imageBytes` + `mimeType` on the Gemini API; `bytesBase64Encoded` or `gcsUri` + `mimeType` on Vertex)
lixpiValue: veoParams.image, set at google-provider.ts:845 for a first-frame request
summary: Supplies one opening image for image-to-video generation. Veo animates this exact image as the first frame; adding config.lastFrame changes the task into first-and-last-frame interpolation.
combines: Supported on all active Veo 3.1 models through the Gemini Developer API and Vertex.
Exactly one image; there is no multi-image first-frame mode.
Vertex recommends 720p or higher and a 16:9 or 9:16 ratio; other ratios or sizes may be resized or centrally cropped.
Pair with `config.lastFrame` to switch this mode into first-and-last-frame interpolation.
range: No input-size limit is documented for active Veo 3.1 models on the Gemini Developer API.

usage.from: state.videoFirstFrameImage, resolved from the selected canvas reference
usage.what: Converts the selected image data URL to Gemini image bytes and sends it as the source image unless video extension takes precedence.
